items.headline: Michael Burry warns the stock market is in the first stage of a crash -- with just 6 to 9 months to go until Stage 2
items.summary: Famed "Big Short" investor Michael Burry isn't letting go of his bearish views towards Wall Street. "The stock market is quite obviously in its first stage of grief, denial," Burry recently wrote on X.

items.headline: U.S. stock futures steady after tech rally lifts S&P 500, Nasdaq to records By Investing.com
items.summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock futures were little changed on Tuesday evening after the S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit record closing highs, as investors turned their attention to Federal Reserve meeting minutes and the start of the third-quarter earnings season.
